itemKeys: While purchasing a tower, the panel will now automatically be hidden.
Tower panel can now be hidden through a new button.
All current maps have had adjustments to their placement zones to account for these changes.
Added multiple toggles for dialogue sections
Added the option to replay dialogue sections
Added option to create an account and log in. This should allow you to play on various devices while not losing progress.
Ui has been adjusted across the entire game. This is part 1 of the larger overhaul to our visual style. Expect the final part of this update to come during our next patch.
Footstep noises have been adjusted across all units to better fit animation.
Levels 1-2 and 1-4 have had seperate adjustments to the placement zones to ensure the placement matches closer to the visuals.
Fixed overlapping footstep noises causing loud repetitive noises.
